scope: Publish exact source/results bytes with bounded, reconstructible JSON chunks.

summary.scope: Complete280-state independent wide-reference audit and initial-guess equivalence

wide_temporal_audit.scope: Audit common-time full-arm contact fields with one unchanged closed initial state.
wide_temporal_audit.limitations: All steps retain complete original1e-9 body/joint/fresh-step budgets, common closure arrays and identical declared initial velocities. This tests the short hold at one coarse fixed-polyhedron/contact setting. It does not establish original approach/lift/support-history matching, spatial/contact/regularization convergence, resolved-load/native feedback separation or a physical accuracy/cost range.

original_to_wide_equivalence.scope: Compare every accepted original state with the corresponding wide-coordinate history.
original_to_wide_equivalence.limitations: Every saved original accepted state, all original array fields and full corner/quadrature tensors are compared. Original incomplete histories remain incomplete. Independent complete force audits are separate requirements. Rounding diagnostics quantify observable arithmetic; they do not establish physical spatial/contact accuracy or original-history matching.

all280_state_initial_guess_equivalence.scope: Compare every accepted original state with the corresponding wide-coordinate history.
all280_state_initial_guess_equivalence.limitations: Every saved original accepted state, all original array fields and full corner/quadrature tensors are compared. Original incomplete histories remain incomplete. Independent complete force audits are separate requirements. Rounding diagnostics quantify observable arithmetic; they do not establish physical spatial/contact accuracy or original-history matching.

limitations: Moving0.1s holds and the original0.1s ground-supported prefix pass scoped independent gates. The original3.3s approach/grasp/lift remains separate unverified work. Physical spatial/contact/geometry tails, complete history, remaining load-model sensitivity, feedback operating ranges and verified warmed accuracy/cost remain incomplete. Exact scientific and startup failures are retained; no force gate is relaxed. Newton-count observations are reference-only and are not native warmed cost claims. Only terminal cases are published. JSON files above200MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original JSON exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
